text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. TMG Builders is constructing a 49-storey commercial and residential building and a 38-storey condominium building at 8 Widmer Street and 28-30 Widmer Street. The site is located on the southeast corner of Adelaide Street West and Widmer Street. The development is currently in progress, operating under a monthly Street Occupation Permit. Transportation Services is requesting approval to close the west sidewalk and a portion of the southbound curb lane on Widmer Street for a period of 44 months (i.e. March 13, 2019 to November 30, 2023) to accommodate a construction staging area.
